trades.notes: Pharma defensive profile as safe haven against crude spike and geopolitical headwinds. Weak Rupee = export advantage. Stock showed extreme relative strength — absorbing selling pressure while Nifty bled. Institutional backing confirmed.
trades.execution: Perfect execution. Entry timed well, target hit exactly as planned.

trades.strategy: Bear Call Spread — tactical index short
trades.notes: Initiated as tactical short to play sell-on-rise momentum when index was struggling near 23,500 support. Thesis invalidated by V-shape recovery that broke decisively above 23,500. Trade cut decisively at stop loss — correct decision.
trades.execution: Short strike placed too close to the money during volatile recovery. Short 23,500 CE was only ~50 pts OTM during high-VIX morning. Should have used 23,600 CE / 23,800 CE to allow more breathing room.

lessons.detail: Cut losses immediately when thesis is invalidated. The hedge (23700 CE) offset Rs 8,554 of the Rs 18,378 short loss. Theoretical max loss was Rs 48,256 — actual was Rs 9,824. Hedge worked.

lessons.rule: No index trades in the first hour on gap-down / high-VIX days
lessons.detail: The spread was forced too early during morning panic. Wait for 10:30 stabilisation before any index position. Best trade in volatile first hour is often no trade.
lessons.nias_note: NIAS v3 blocks trading until 10:30 on gap-down days (auto-configured at startup)

lessons.detail: Short strike must be at least 1.5x ATR OTM. Example: Short 23,600 CE / Long 23,800 CE instead of 23,500 / 23,700 to allow the trade room to breathe against theta decay.
lessons.nias_note: NIAS v3 calculates and suggests OTM strikes based on live ATR in every signal

lessons.rule: Trail stops to VWAP, not a tight percentage buffer
lessons.detail: 0.5% trailing invites stop-loss hunting in high-volatility sessions. Trail to VWAP or cost price to give the trend maximum room to run.
lessons.nias_note: NIAS v3 displays live VWAP level as the trailing stop in every signal alert

lessons.rule: Pair defensive equity longs with index shorts as hedge
lessons.detail: Sun Pharma long fully absorbed the impact of the index whipsaw. Portfolio hedging across sectors reduces net daily P&L volatility.
lessons.nias_note: NIAS v3 flags defensive sector stocks separately when VIX > 18
